newsitem.title: CHINA: Tibet Jinzhu to list 13.5 mln A shares on Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: Tibet Jinzhu to list 13.5 mln A shares on Nov 8.

text.p: Tibet Jinzhu, the third Tibetan firm to issue domestic A shares, will list 13.5 million of its shares on November 8 on the Shanghai stock exchange, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The 13.5 million A shares were issued between October 7 and October 15 at a price of 5.36 yuan per share, the statement said.

The A shares account for 26.06 percent of the company's share capital. The company also has 1.5 million shares held by employees and 36.8 million shares held by state-owned institutions in Tibet, it said.
Tibet Jinzhu, a trading company, will invest the proceeds from the issue largely in agricultural, mining and processing projects to help the firm expand beyond its trading business, it said.

In the first half of 1996, the company posted net profits of 7.44 million yuan on turnover of 84.4 million yuan, and it forecast net profits of 16.7 million yuan on turnover of 237 million in all 1996.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 10.9 million yuan on turnover of 159.7 million yuan, it said but gave no comparative figures.
